description: Canonical interaction behaviors (M7.1, taxonomy/behaviors.json). These describe WHAT AN COMPONENT DOES with user input — how its animation is triggered — not how it looks (taxonomy/aesthetics.json) and not its tech stack (taxonomy/attributes.json). A component may carry several behaviors at once. Classification rule (MASTER_SPEC.md §5.4): an animation that plays on its own with no user input is 'auto'; only components that respond to pointer, keyboard, drag, scroll or state changes carry the matching interactive behavior. Ids are referenced from entry 'behaviors' arrays and enforced by the validator.

behaviors.label: Autonomous
behaviors.description: Plays by itself; no user input required (loop timers, continuous shaders, entrance-on-mount).

behaviors.label: Cursor-reactive
behaviors.description: Responds to pointer position: tracking, magnetic pull, parallax, or bend toward the cursor.

behaviors.label: Hover interaction
behaviors.description: Transforms while the pointer rests over it (glare, tilt, pixel flood, dock magnification).

behaviors.label: Click-triggered
behaviors.description: A click or tap fires the effect (sparks, scramble waves, physics release).

behaviors.label: Drag & physics
behaviors.description: Supports dragging with momentum or spring physics (@use-gesture, matter-js, or pointer-drag).

behaviors.label: Scroll-triggered
behaviors.description: Driven by viewport entry or scroll position (fade/fade-blur on view, in-view entrances).

behaviors.label: Gesture-driven
behaviors.description: Multi-input gestures: pinch, wheel, two-axis drag, or elastic release beyond a plain click.

behaviors.label: Interactive 3D / WebGL
behaviors.description: WebGL/3D scenes that accept pointer or wheel input (orbit, slosh, dangle, warp).

behaviors.label: Interactive text
behaviors.description: Text whose glyphs respond to input: hover effects, click bursts, or cursor pressure.

behaviors.label: Interactive navigation
behaviors.description: Menus, docks, breadcrumbs and nav patterns whose structure animates with interaction (open/close, magnify, flow, stagger reveal).

behaviors.label: Stateful transitions
behaviors.description: UI-state transitions respond to interaction: steppers, menus opening, tab/step changes, nav folds.

behaviors.label: Static
behaviors.description: No motion and no interaction; plain informational UI.
